title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: service contract discount on the surcharge
content:
## Rule
For the hazardous-cargo surcharge written at loading under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the customer's contract tier rank is read from the tier of the service contract the customer holds in status active — 1 for AHL Starter Service Contract, 2 for AHL Standard Service Contract, 3 for AHL Regional Account Contract, 4 for AHL Key Account Contract, 5 for AHL Global Account Contract and 6 for AHL Strategic Partner Contract — and is 0 when the customer holds no active service contract; expired, suspended, terminated and unsigned contracts never count. When the category's minimum rank is not 0 and the customer's rank is at least that minimum, the uplifted surcharge per container is reduced by the category's contract discount percentage; otherwise it is not reduced.

## Category figures
| Category | Minimum contract rank for the discount | Contract discount (percent) |
|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 0 | 0 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 5 | 10 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 5 | 10 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 5 | 10 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 5 | 10 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 0 | 0 |

A minimum rank of 0 means that the category grants no contract discount.

## Truth table (hypothetical customers)
| Category | Customer's service contracts | Rank | Discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | AHL Global Account Contract, active | 5 | 10 percent — 5 is at least 5 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | AHL Strategic Partner Contract, active | 6 | 10 percent |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | AHL Key Account Contract, active | 4 | none — 4 is below 5 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | AHL Strategic Partner Contract, expired | 0 | none — an expired contract never counts |
| AHL DG Special Approval | AHL Strategic Partner Contract, active | 6 | none — the category's minimum rank is 0 |
